verdict.rationale: First-party docs claim conversion between 200+ formats, explicitly naming PNG, JPEG, WebP and HEIC. They show a PNG-to-WebP conversion with `-quality 85` and aspect-preserving `-resize`, and community users corroborate batch scaling of thousands of images. SVG is not in the first-party format list; only a community warning implies ImageMagick processes it, and that warning concerns security risk rather than whether conversion works. Missing for 10: first-party confirmation of SVG conversion, documentation of per-format compression controls beyond `-quality` (e.g. PNG compression level, lossless WebP/HEIC settings).
